name: Wellness Ayurvedic Treatments
seoTitle: Wellness Ayurvedic Treatments - OmShree Sidha Hospital
seoDescription: Omshree Sidha Hospital offers wellness Ayurvedic treatments including detoxification, rejuvenation, stress relief, skin care, and programs for obesity and diabetes.
quickAnswer: Our wellness treatments include detoxification, rejuvenation therapy, and programs to remove stress, toxins, skin problems, pain, and sexual disorders.
whatItMeans: Wellness Ayurvedic Treatments focus on holistic healing, balancing the body, mind, and soul, and preventing long-term diseases through detoxification and rejuvenation.
ayurvedicContext: These treatments utilize traditional Ayurvedic methods such as Panchakarma, Shirodhara, Pinda Swedana, and specialized herbal massages.
howTreatmentIsPlanned: Treatments typically range from 7 to 28 days and involve a combination of massages, steam baths, internal medicines, and therapeutic purgation.
whoShouldSeek: Anyone seeking relief from stress, skin problems, arthritis, asthma, sexual disorders, obesity, or diabetes, or simply wanting to maintain overall health and vitality.
patientJourney: Patients undergo a personalized regimen of therapies and massages, leading to reduced stress, improved immunity, and a rejuvenated body and mind.
